basic.name: tool
basic.description: A small tool for exercising commander.

commands.name: send
commands.description: Send a message to a target.

commands.name: setup
commands.description: Set up the thing with a rather long description that needs wrapping across multiple lines of help output.

cases.stdout:
Usage: tool [options] [command]

A small tool for exercising commander.

Options:
  -V, --version                      output the version number
  -p, --profile <slug>               Profile slug to use.
  -v, --verbose                      Verbose output.
  -h, --help                         display help for command

Commands:
  send [options] <target> [rest...]  Send a message to a target.
  task                               Task operations
  status                             Show status.
  help [command]                     display help for command

Usage: tool send [options] <target> [rest...]

Send a message to a target.

Arguments:
  target
  rest              Extra words.

Options:
  --content <text>  Message content.
  -n, --count <n>   How many.
  --tag <tag>       Repeatable tag.
  --trace <v>       Parser previous trace.
  --limit <n>       Validated number.
  --dry-run         Do not send.
  --mode [mode]     Optional value. (default: "fast")
  -a                Short flag a.
  -b                Short flag b.
  -c <val>          Short with value.
  -h, --help        display help for command

Examples:
  tool send #general --content hi

Usage: tool task [options] [command]

Task operations

Options:
  -h, --help       display help for command

Commands:
  claim [options]  Claim a task by number.
  list             List tasks.
  help [command]   display help for command
